notes: as to before the fronted nephesh kol basar is added: no object marker and no preposition stands on that phrase, which is exactly the case rule 16 reserves for an added as for, headed on as.
Both copular pronouns take the ASV's is, consistently within the verse.

dam kol basar lo' to'khelu is read with the single no fused across kol and lo' (rule 35), the chain's of going to kol as the rectum under rule 19 and manner of flesh staying with the noun under rule 31.

all one with is read as one rendering of the beth of identity under rule 49, headed on with because that word does realize the preposition's lexeme (rule 24's first branch); the competing reading leaves the italicized all one added.
